composition.serve_who: This sheet (GMMS 108'-114a, "BILGE SYSTEM") serves the vessel's bilge pump/valve/monitoring group: the MAIN BILGE PUMP (motor, top of sheet, fed via F3 60A/SW8/SO6), the BILGE VALVES (six motorised valve controllers Re1-Re6 driving open/close on Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng. Room, Fwd, Sail Locker bilge lines), and the bilge level switches/monitoring loop that reports each compartment's bilge state to the MAIN PANEL and MAIN PANEL PC CARD (indicator lamps, S20-S24 selector switches, S13 pump switch). The register's engineer-confirmed vocabulary maps BILGE PUMP -> 520-main-bilge-pump and BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves; the bilge level switches and monitoring path belong to the bilge valves' control loop (they command/read back the same 6 valves) so are grouped there. MAIN PANEL itself is infrastructure (641-vessel-control-panel) providing the switch/plug/PC-card housing, not equipment in its own right; T/S S, T/S B, T/S C terminal strips, Re1-Re6 relay bank and the XA-tag stub wires are the shared wiring/terminal infrastructure connecting these two equipment groups to the panel.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Top-of-sheet motor labeled 'MAIN BILGE PUMP', fed via F3 60A fuse, SW8 switch and SO6 relay/solenoid, with a local pump switch (T/S S, LOCAL PUMP SW) and remote command via S13 on the Main Panel. Matches engineer mapping BILGE PUMP -> 520-main-bilge-pump.

functions.label: Main bilge pump run/stop control
functions.what_it_does: Drives the main bilge pump motor to clear bilge water from the vessel, switchable either locally at the pump or remotely from the Main Panel bilge pump switch S13.

flow_scenarios.path: +24V service battery -> F3 60A fuse -> SW8 -> SO6 relay (de-energised) -> pump motor idle
+24V service bat. -> F3 60A -> SW8 -> T/S S terminals 13/14/15 -> LOCAL PUMP SW (contact 1/2) closed -> SO6 energised -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs -> overboard discharge
MAIN PANEL bilge pump switch S13 -> PLUG C -> T/S wiring -> SO6 relay coil energised -> MAIN BILGE PUMP motor runs

key_components: T/S S terminal strip (local switch interface)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC motor pump; fed via F3 60A fuse, SW8 switch, SO6 relay; local switch at T/S S terminals 13-15, remote switch S13 on Main Panel
functions.sheet_region: top of sheet (~0.05-0.25 vertical), left-to-right from F3 60A fuse to MAIN BILGE PUMP motor symbol

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Bilge Valves (with associated bilge level switches)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Six motorised valve blocks each captioned 'BILGE VALVE ENG. ROOM BILGE' (per caption-attaches-to-device-below convention) are commanded via Re1-Re6 relays and OPEN/CLOSE contact pairs from T/S C, each valve line paired with a bilge level switch (Port/Stbd Lazarette, Aft, Eng Room, Fwd, Sail Locker) whose status is read back to the Main Panel PC Card. Matches engineer mapping BILGE VALVES -> 520-bilge-valves; the compartment bilge switches are the sensors for this same valve-selection loop, not separate equipment nodes in this register.

functions.what_it_does: Opens/closes the bilge valve routing the Port and Stbd Lazarette bilge lines to the main bilge pump manifold, and reports lazarette bilge-full status back to the Main Panel indicator (LAZARETTE BILGE).

facts: MAIN PANEL provides PLUG C (7-pin) and PLUG D (12-pin) connectors distributing bilge valve open/closed status to indicator switches S20 (Lazarette), S21 (Aft), S22 (Eng. Room), S23 (Fwd), S24 (Sail Locker) and pump switch S13.
MAIN PANEL PC CARD is the indicator/logic card behind the panel with open/closed lamp pairs for each of the 5 monitored bilge compartments, a diode array, and +24V supply.
PEDESTAL ALARM + MUTE / ALARM MOD wired via a 12-terminal strip to PLUG D and to an AUX PLUG on the PC board ([8]->>[1] etc.) for audible alarm/mute function shared across the panel.
T/S S, T/S B, T/S C are terminal strips distributing supply and control signals between the relay bank Re1-Re6, the bilge valves, and the Main Panel; Bilge Valves fed from breaker Q13 10A.
Numbers in diamonds on T/S C wires (12,13,21,22,29,30,37,38,45,46) are wire-gauge callouts, not devices.

uncertainties: T/S S local pump switch relay contact wiring (terminals 13/14/15) is partially ambiguous per prior extraction - exact contact routing to SO6 not fully certain.

XA40/XA10/XA11 tags are treated as status-signal taps to a monitoring/alarm loom per sheet convention, but their exact downstream destination (which monitoring bus) beyond 'to ONYX' for XA11<32> is not explicitly labeled on this sheet.
PLUG C pins 6 and 7 destinations are unclear/unlabeled in the extraction.
Re6 / terminal 13 function ('not used' on contact 12) suggests this relay may be partially unused or spare - not fully certain of its active role beyond the ONYX tap.
Bottom-right secondary tables (PLUG D header fragments referencing PROJECT/CUSTOMER) appear to be illegible duplicate/title-block artifacts, not distinct data.
